name: @didactica/design-system
description: Design system extracted from the “Manual de Didáctica Universitaria”: tokens, Tailwind preset, React components, plain HTML/CSS and a SQLite token database served by Node.js.

scripts.build:css: tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.cjs -i src/styles/didactica.css -o dist/didactica.css && node scripts/prepend-fonts.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:tokens && npm run build:css && npm run build:js && npm run build:db && npm run build:demo
